anti_overlap: Leave inertness of the null model itself to fd-sake-bodai-moto-parallel-ferment
Focus narrowly on temporal-boundary measurement correctness
decision_lens: Is year_end_remaining measured at the correct tick — specifically on the last tick of the year, before the reset-on-year event fires? Measurement at or after the reset boundary yields a meaningless always-full reading.
distance_rationale: A non-Western sacred-calendrical tradition with millennia of precision around measurement-on-boundary correctness, semantically far from software timing but structurally isomorphic to cycle-reset sample timing.
expected_isomorphisms: The tithi-boundary rule that offerings are null after transition maps directly to the requirement that AttentionBudget be sampled strictly before reset_on_year. Both traditions treat cycle boundaries as discontinuities where measurement semantics must be declared.
focus: Auditing the year-boundary reset and emit semantics using the Vedic shraddha (ancestral-rite) tradition's obsessive care about tithi (lunar-day) boundaries, where offerings made on the wrong side of a boundary are null — the correctness of the ritual depends on measuring the scarce item (offerings remaining before sunrise) at exactly the right moment relative to the boundary.
name: fd-vedic-pitr-shraddha-tithi-boundary
persona: Apply the perspective of a traditional Vedic ritualist (purohita) specializing in shraddha timing — they care about whether a measurement of 'what remains' is taken BEFORE the tithi (lunar day) transitions, they measure using multiple independent clocks (shadow length, panchanga tables) to avoid single-source error, and they flag when a ritual count is taken at or after the transition because the scarce items have been ritually reset. Here the 'tithi' is the sim year boundary and the 'count' is year_end remaining.
review_areas: Whether 'year-end' means the final tick of year N or the first tick of year N+1 — off-by-one here silently invalidates the entire calibration
Whether the reset-on-year event and the emit event are ordered deterministically in the sim tick loop
Whether the /bench/attention-budget HTTP endpoint polled at year boundaries races the sim's reset (risk #1 mitigation proposes this fallback)
Whether there is a trace event distinguishing 'pre-reset snapshot' from 'post-reset snapshot' — without this distinction, calibration is ambiguous
Whether multi-year runs confirm the reset is idempotent and that remaining is not carried across years through any stale state
